answer: A newcomer becomes a sparrow courier, carrying a signed record of one real task past three random agents, each signing only after checking it, to the summit ledger. It must carry the day's zephyr code, so a stale copy dies at the first hop. Five random agents audit it within 48 hours; a broken link slashes the $2 bond and bars the key. One honest courier delivers in an hour; a farm faking 100 identities faces 300 random checks and $200 locked.
